title: Matrix move assignment through a base reference exchanges the memory of a ResizableMatrix or LinkedDataMatrix but not its allocation
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG7.3.4 point 16: MatrixBase::operator=(MatrixBase&&) swaps data, rows and columns; called on a ResizableMatrix through Matrix& (as the access functions take it), allocatedSize keeps the old capacity, so a later resize within it writes past the moved-in buffer - the heap corruption of c3d53a99, reproduced with AddressSanitizer (heap-buffer-overflow); on a LinkedDataMatrix the temporary deletes the linked memory. Fix in the Linalg classes (a virtual move that copies for the derived classes, or no move assignment through the base), not in each caller.
releaseNotes: the assignments of the matrices and vectors keep memory and capacity consistent: the move assignment of Matrix copies when a ResizableMatrix or LinkedDataMatrix is on either side, ResizableMatrix and ResizableVector have copy assignments that keep their own capacity (the generated ones copied the other's), ResizableMatrix a move assignment with its capacity; unit tests under AddressSanitizer (revision2026c step RG7.3.4.1)
